style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for the packshot, warm off-white #F2EDE6 for banner, grid and infographic screens, terracotta #A6431F header bands and badge fields, deep charcoal #312C27 dark copy panels, sun-warmed tan headliner #B98A5E for in-cabin screens
style.direction: premium natural-material automotive interior fragrance ecommerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line icons of abstract material marks inside open frames, cream #F2EDE6 on dark panels and charcoal #312C27 on light panels, rounded-square tiles with generous corner radius and blank label slots beneath each
style.lightingSystem: warm neutral 3200-4500K; bright even high-key softbox key with soft fill and soft contact shadows on all studio screens; low warm sunlight with a gentle flare inside the cabin; skimming light reserved for grain macro only, one controlled highlight, never blown speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium natural-material automotive interior fragrance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm off-white #F2EDE6, terracotta #A6431F, deep charcoal #312C27 and one timber honey accent #B0703A; warm neutral lighting with bright even high-key softbox light on studio screens and low warm sunlight flares inside the cabin; high-contrast serif display headlines paired with one modern geometric sans-serif for labels; single-weight thin-line icon system with rounded-square swatch tiles and blank label slots; solid timber always rendered with open visible grain seated in a slim metal clip rail; stable product scale and centering; one complete balanced layout per screen; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no added wordmark, engraving or seal artwork on the timber face
style.presentationRules: the timber always reads as one solid rectangular piece seated in a slim metal clip rail, stable scale and centering, shown standing on a plinth, clipped inside the cabin, or inset small inside infographic screens; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale stone plinth #E4DCCF and rough concrete block #C9C2B6 for studio screens, tan fabric headliner and blind vent slats for cabin screens
style.typography: high-contrast serif display headlines paired with one modern geometric sans-serif for small labels, charcoal #312C27 lettering on light panels and cream #F2EDE6 lettering on dark panels, one headline plus up to four short labels per screen
